note: Tech Bila Hype EP.2. Companion to EP.1: same rig, same motion grammar, voice-led cut, Kiswahili VO (scratch TTS for review - owner records his own read for the final; copy.json is the record of the exact words). POV: apps you are paying for that you could start for free - the three beats point at the free guide (Tech Bila Hype PDF, 12 real tools). copy.json is the record of the exact words spoken.

sw: Kipindi cha pili: tools za bure.
en: Welcome to Tech Bila Hype. Episode two: free tools.
takes.say: Karibu Tech Bila Hype. Kipindi cha pili: tools za bure.

en: Every month you pay for apps you could get free. Nobody tells you.
takes.say: Kila mwezi unalipa apps unazoweza kupata bure. Hakuna anayekwambia - kila mtu anauza tu.

sw: Kanuni ya kwanza: ikiwa kuna free tier,
en: Rule one: if there is a free tier, start with it. Docs, Drive, Meet.
takes.say: Kanuni ya kwanza: ikiwa kuna free tier, anza nayo. Docs, Drive, Meet - zote za bure.

sw: Kanuni ya pili: Canva na CapCut.
Design na video - free tier inatosha.
en: Rule two: Canva and CapCut. Design and video - the free tier is enough.
takes.say: Kanuni ya pili: Canva na CapCut. Design na video - free tier inatosha kuanzia.

sw: Kanuni ya tatu: jaribu free kwanza.
en: Rule three: try free first. Only pay once it proves not enough.
takes.say: Kanuni ya tatu: jaribu free kwanza. Ukiona haitoshi, ndipo ulipe.

sw: Comment PDF - nitakutumia mwongozo wa tools 12 za bure. Altraware.
en: That is it. Comment PDF - I will send you the free guide to 12 tools. Altraware.
takes.say: Hiyo ndiyo. Zaidi: comment PDF, nitakutumia mwongozo wa tools 12 za bure. Altraware.
